item.title: Burbank airport says safety is 'top priority' after warning over possible mid-air collision
item.description: Hollywood Burbank Airport officials are responding one day after the chair of the NTSB suggested the airport could be the next to experience a mid-air collision.

item.title: Winter warmup to bring 80‑degree temps to SoCal this week
item.description: A winter warmup is on the way for Southern California, with temperatures jumping into the 80s and possibly even the 90s in some areas.

item.title: Gov. Newsom reviewing Dr. Oz video that appears to target Van Nuys bakery
item.description: Gov. Gavin Newsom says his office is taking a close look at a video Dr. Oz shot in the San Fernando Valley and reviewing reports that he targeted the local Armenian American community.

item.title: Federal agents tackled, used Taser on man in Compton, witness says
item.description: A man says federal agents tackled and used a Taser on a man who is a U.S. citizen in Compton. The man was detained and later released.

item.title: San Bernardino police secure $1M in federal funding for 100 new surveillance cameras across city
item.description: San Bernardino police announced that the department received more than $1 million in federal funding to help fight crime with new surveillance cameras.

item.title: Large fire at metal recycling center sends massive plume of smoke into air in South El Monte
item.description: A large fire erupted at a metal recycling center in South El Monte on Wednesday, creating a massive plume of smoke visible for miles across the San Gabriel Valley.

item.title: Search warrant FBI served at elections office near Atlanta seeks records tied to the 2020 elections
item.description: The search warrant the FBI served at a Fulton County elections office seeks records tied to the 2020 election, officials say.

item.title: 'Ghost student' scammers are using AI to steal financial aid, federal investigators warn
item.description: Scammers are using AI to fraudulently apply for colleges and collect financial aid, and they're doing it by stealing identities, leaving the victims on the hook to repay loans they didn't take out.

item.title: Tesla CEO Elon Musk to stop production of models S and X; convert Fremont factory to produce robots
item.description: Tesla's annual profit plunged to its lowest level since the pandemic five years ago. Now, Elon Musk said Tesla would be closing down production of two car models and convert the Fremont, California, factory to produce its Optimus robots.

item.title: Person found dead after fire in alley behind 7-Eleven in Miracle Mile
item.description: A person died following a fire in an alley behind a 7-Eleven in the Miracle Mile area of Los Angeles.
